Paddy Power directly lists Hedges +450 in a three-way market; removing that book's overround produces an approximately +507 fair price. FanDuel +470 and Unibet +475 are aggregator references, so the new Hedges watch requires a directly confirmed three-way +600.

Paddy Power directly lists Bravo +450, with its three-way market normalizing near +507. Current aggregator references span +425 to +510, but the best number is not a directly confirmed executable three-way quote.

Nursultanov remains independently relevant: direct Paddy Power +350 is below its approximately +395 normalized fair price, while current aggregator references range from +340 to +475. The +500 direct three-way trigger is unchanged.

The watchlist now contains two active MAIN fights and one active CO_MAIN fight, all on Sept. 19 and outside 30 hours. The internal Bet365/DraftKings snapshot-first rule did not trigger, so there are zero exact-match internal misses.
